system.description:
Transforms surrounding vegetable matter into [[/r 2d4]] Moldmen (Vegepygmies) of [[/r 1d2]] HD that obey the caster's commands until the spell ends (when they flee at full speed).

Moldmen Stats: AL N, MV 120' (40'), AC 4 (AAC 15), HD 1 or 2 (HP 6 or 10), #AT 1 (1d6), SV F1, ML 10.
